subject: two colour scales on the same plot

messages.author: bf88c5bfbffaf252
messages.subject: two colour scales on the same plot
parts:
hi i would like to combine a colour scale gradient for the points on a scatter plot together with a colour scale gradient for some text that goes on the plot. I can do them separately as shown in my example below, but i can't seem to put them together...is there a way of doing this?

Here is my example code of the two types of plots (p and p1) that I want to combine

l <- data.frame(prev=rnorm(1266), 
aft=rnorm(1266), 
day=as.factor(wday(sample(c(2:6),1266,replace=TRUE),abbr=TRUE, label=TRUE)), 
month=as.factor(month(Sys.Date()+months(sample(0:11,1266,replace=TRUE)),abbr=TRUE, label=TRUE)), 
ind=c(1:1266))
cors <- ddply(l, c("month", "day"), summarise, cor = round(cor(prev, aft), 3))


# below the text gains the colour gradient
 p <- ggplot(l, aes(x=prev, y=aft)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high="blue")+ 
  facet_grid(day~month, scales="free_x")+
  geom_text(data=cors,aes(label=paste("r= ",cor,sep=""), size=abs(cor), colour=cor), x=Inf, y=Inf, vjust=1, hjust=1, show_guide=FALSE)+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0))+
  geom_smooth(method="loess")
p

# below the points gain the colour gradient
p1 <- ggplot(l, aes(x=prev, y=aft)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour=ind)) + 
scale_colour_gradient("gray")+ 
facet_grid(day~month, scales="free_x")+
geom_text(data=cors,aes(label=paste("r= ",cor,sep=""), size=abs(cor), colour=cor), x=Inf, y=Inf, vjust=1, hjust=1, show_guide=FALSE)+
geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0))+
opts(legend.position="none") +
geom_smooth(method="loess")

p1

messages.subject: Re: two colour scales on the same plot
parts: My initial reply which I forgot to send to the list too:

> On 2012-Aug-01, at 05:31 , hlm <hideyos...@gmail.com> wrote:
>>
>> hi i would like to combine a colour scale gradient for the points on a scatter plot together with a colour scale gradient for some text that goes on the plot. I can do them separately as shown in my example below, but i can't seem to put them together...is there a way of doing this?
>

> It's not possible to have two scales of the same nature in the same plot. You could have a gradient and a discrete colour scale but not two gradients.


On 2012-Aug-01, at 07:40 , Hideyoshi Maeda <hideyos...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> how would one go about adding the discrete gradient?
>
> for the points...rather than the text...

It would not be a gradient by default since it would be a discrete colour scale. You could make it look like a gradient by using scale_colour_manual.
Now, you cannot use scale_colour_manual with continuous data. You need to use cut() to cut your continuous data in bins.
But beware that this is just an ugly workaround.


I also feel that it would be worthwhile to have several colour scales on the same plot, as long as the user makes them different enough. See the related issue on github: https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/578
I understand however that this might be complex to implement.
